sources.title: Early education and childcare
sources.verified_claim: DfE's current statutory guidance sets local-authority duties for early education and childcare from 1 April 2026. Statutory duties define the sufficiency framework but do not establish facility capacity at a sample parcel.

sources.title: School-age childcare guidance for school and local authorities
sources.verified_claim: DfE's collection covers local-authority capacity funding, school-age childcare delivery and related programmes. Guidance and programme routes are not evidence of a provider or place being available at a sample parcel.

sources.title: School-age childcare sufficiency funding for local authorities
sources.verified_claim: The 2026-27 guidance supports local authorities in securing and maintaining school-age childcare systems including wraparound provision. Funding availability is system support and not a site-specific childcare commitment.

sources.title: Early years funding: 2026 to 2027
sources.verified_claim: DfE publishes the 2026-27 early-years funding framework and national funding-formula material. Funding rules support entitlement delivery but do not prove capacity in a local catchment or at a sample parcel.

sources.title: Inclusive early years fund: 2026 to 2027
sources.verified_claim: The Inclusive Early Years Fund provides additional 2026-27 support to local authorities for SEND inclusion in free-entitlement provision. Grant support does not establish local provider headroom at the sample parcels.

sources.title: Setting up childcare provision
sources.verified_claim: Enfield links its Childcare Sufficiency Assessment 2025 and SEND assessment and describes them as studies of childcare supply and demand. Market analysis does not establish capacity at parcel_30762.

sources.title: School Place Planning and Provision
sources.verified_claim: Havering's place-planning page states its plan covers early years through post-16 and links a Childcare Sufficiency Report under the Childcare Act duty. Borough sufficiency planning is not exact parcel childcare capacity.

sources.title: Childcare Sufficiency Assessment
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth explains its annual duty to report on sufficient childcare and states its role is market facilitation rather than direct provision. The latest linked assessment is 2024, so report age is retained and no parcel capacity is inferred.
